evidence: TBTDET, a liquid precursor at room temperature with high vapor pressure (0.1 Torr at 336 K), was evaporated in a bubbler at 70°C. A mixture of 5 mol % methane in hydrogen and pure hydrogen was used to adjust the methane content in the mixture. Pure argon (99.9999%) was used as a purge gas and as a carrier gas of TBTDET.
